body: Ye’s “All of the Lights” has officially surpassed 1 BILLION streams on Spotify, becoming the 16th song from his catalog to reach the milestone 🤯🔥 Released nearly 16 years ago as part of My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy, the fan-favorite track features Rihanna on its unforgettable hook alongside additional vocals from Kid Cudi, Alicia Keys, Elton John, Fergie, Drake @champagnepapi, John Legend, Charlie Wilson and more. “All of the Lights” peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and went on to win Best Rap Song and Best Rap/Sung Collaboration at the 2012 Grammy Awards 🏆 Nearly two decades later, all of the lights are still shining. Where does this rank in Ye’s discography? 👀 🎥:

source_caption_text:
Ye’s “All of the Lights” has officially surpassed 1 BILLION streams on Spotify, becoming the 16th song from his catalog to reach the milestone 🤯🔥

Released nearly 16 years ago as part of My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy, the fan-favorite track features Rihanna on its unforgettable hook alongside additional vocals from Kid Cudi, Alicia Keys, Elton John, Fergie, Drake, John Legend, Charlie Wilson and more.

“All of the Lights” peaked at No. 18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and went on to win Best Rap Song and Best Rap/Sung Collaboration at the 2012 Grammy Awards 🏆

Nearly two decades later, all of the lights are still shining. Where does this rank in Ye’s discography? 👀
